---
title: "04 Assemble the archive package for NCEI"
subtitle: "Images, TSV, DwC-A, metadata, SHA-256 manifest, verified locally. No submission."
---

```{mermaid}
%%| file: diagrams/ncei.mmd
```

## Status

The package layout below is a **proposal** to agree with NCEI and with Matt Biddle and Enrique Montes,
who are already working on NCEI publication of EcoTaxa data (the SECOORA LOI also names FathomNet in that
work). It is BagIt-style because a checksummed, self-describing bag survives any transport. Which route NCEI
prefers (Send2NCEI for a one-off, ATRAC with a submission agreement for a recurring flow, or a FathomNet-mediated
path) and which metadata profile the imaging pipeline requires are the first questions for them; nothing here
is an NCEI decision, and nothing here submits.

```{r}
#| label: setup
librarian::shelf(dplyr, readr, tibble, jsonlite, digest, here, quiet = TRUE)
for (f in list.files(here("R"), pattern = "\\.R$", full.names = TRUE)) source(f)
PROJECT_ID  <- ecotaxa_project_id()
DATASET_KEY <- paste0("ecotaxa-om-prj", PROJECT_ID)
VERSION     <- format(Sys.Date())
DIR_EXPORT  <- here("data/export", paste0("project-", PROJECT_ID))
DIR_DWCA    <- here("data/darwincore", DATASET_KEY)
DIR_NCEI    <- here("data/ncei")
export_info <- fromJSON(file.path(DIR_EXPORT, "export.json"))
meta        <- read_project_meta(here("metadata/projects.csv"), PROJECT_ID)
project     <- ecotaxa_projects() |> filter(projid == PROJECT_ID)
str(export_info)
# NCEI accepts no non-commercial license: stop before packaging rather than after
license_check(meta$license, "ncei")
stopifnot(license_check(meta$license, "ncei")$level == "ok")
```

## Inputs: one project at one dated version

```{r}
#| label: inputs
tsv_paths <- list.files(export_info$image_dir, pattern = "\\.tsv$", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
dwca_zip  <- file.path(DIR_DWCA, paste0(DATASET_KEY, "_", VERSION, ".zip"))
eml_path  <- file.path(DIR_DWCA, "eml.xml")
stopifnot(file.exists(dwca_zip), file.exists(eml_path), length(tsv_paths) > 0)
manifest  <- fromJSON(file.path(DIR_DWCA, paste0(DATASET_KEY, "_", VERSION, "_manifest.json")))
cat(length(tsv_paths), "TSV files;", basename(c(dwca_zip, eml_path)), "\n")
# the TSV columns described from NCEI's draft data dictionary, with the owner's unit corrections
tsv_cols <- names(readr::read_tsv(tsv_paths[1], n_max = 0, show_col_types = FALSE))
coldict  <- ecotaxa_column_dictionary(tsv_cols,
  read_data_dictionary(here("metadata/ecotaxa_data_dictionary.csv")),
  read_column_units(here("metadata/column_units.csv"), PROJECT_ID))
coldict |> count(documented)
# the exported columns the dictionary does not define yet: a list to send back to NCEI
coldict |> filter(!documented) |> pull(field)
```

## Build the bag

```{r}
#| label: build
b <- ncei_package(DIR_NCEI, DATASET_KEY, VERSION, tsv_paths = tsv_paths, image_dir = export_info$image_dir,
                  dwca_zip = dwca_zip, eml_path = eml_path, column_dictionary = coldict,
                  metadata_files = here("metadata", c("sample_fixes.csv", "taxa_review.csv", "column_units.csv",
                                                      paste0("taxa_lookup_project-", PROJECT_ID, ".csv"))),
                  dataset_json = list(
                    organization = meta$organization,
                    title = meta$title,
                    source_project_url = paste0(ecotaxa_url(), "/prj/", PROJECT_ID),
                    dwca_content_hash = manifest$content_hash,
                    instrument = project$instrument,
                    instrument_vocab = project$instrument_url,
                    verification = meta$verification,
                    license = meta$license))
str(b)
# the layout, one line per folder with its file count (a project can hold a million images)
bag_files <- list.files(b$bag, recursive = TRUE)
tibble(folder = ifelse(grepl("/", bag_files), sub("/[^/]+$", "", bag_files), ".")) |>
  mutate(folder = sub("^(data/images/[^/]+)/.*$", "\\1", folder)) |>
  count(folder) |> head(40)
```

```{r}
#| label: tagfiles
cat(readLines(file.path(b$bag, "bag-info.txt")), sep = "\n")
man_lines <- readLines(file.path(b$bag, "manifest-sha256.txt"))
cat(length(man_lines), "payload files in the manifest; the first ten:\n")
cat(head(man_lines, 10), sep = "\n")
```

## Verify

```{r}
#| label: verify
v <- ncei_verify(b$bag)
v
stopifnot(identical(v$finding, "ok"))
```

## What a submission would then look like (assumption, to agree)

1. Copy the bag to the staging bucket (egress-free object storage; a public copy via NODD if NOAA wants one),
   under `ecotaxa/{dataset_key}/{version}/`.
2. Send NCEI the bag's location and `bag-info.txt` through the agreed route (S2N for a pilot; ATRAC with a
   submission agreement for the recurring flow). The ISO 19115-2 record NCEI needs would be generated from the
   same EML with NCEI's template once the profile is agreed; `data/metadata/dataset.json` holds the ACDD-style
   attributes it would draw on.
3. On accession, write the accession number and DOI back into the project's EML, so the next DwC-A version
   cites the archived copy.
4. A re-validation or a new cruise makes a **new version**; a submitted version is never edited.

## Lessons learned (project 4, 2026-11-10)

- **Scale.** Project 4's bag is 10.05 GB, 967,734 images and 967,842 payload files; build, manifest and verify
  (`ok`) take 12 minutes on the mini. Two loops that were fine on
  eight objects were not: copying one image per call (now one vectorized `file.copy`), and `ncei_verify()`
  looking each manifest entry up by name inside a loop, which is quadratic and ran for over half an hour
  without finishing (now one vectorized comparison; a test covers missing, unlisted and changed files together).
- **Spotlight** on macOS indexes every new image and competes for the CPU; `data/.metadata_never_index` (made
  by `scripts/render_project.sh`) keeps it off.
- **One image per object**: exporting with `with_images = "first"` is what removed the duplicate second images
  of the Ifremer backup; an `"all"` export would bring them back into the bag.
- **The data dictionary** NCEI is drafting (`metadata/ecotaxa_data_dictionary.csv`, saved 2026-11-12) becomes
  the bag's `data/metadata/data_dictionary.csv`: each TSV column with its definition and unit, the owner's
  unit where it differs (`sample_total_volume` is L, not mL), and `documented = FALSE` for the columns the
  dictionary does not cover yet. The owner's corrections and the taxa review travel in the same folder, so
  the archived TSVs (as exported) and the published tables (as corrected) can be reconciled.
- Print counts and the first lines, never a million-line listing, into a rendered page.
